entries.title: Isaiah 6:1
segments: ¶In the year that King Uzziah died, I saw the Lord sitting on a throne, high and lifted up, and the train of His [robe] filled the temple.

entries.title: Isaiah 6:2
segments: Above it stood seraphim; each one had six wings: with two he covered his face, with two he covered his feet, and with two he flew.

entries.title: Isaiah 6:3
segments: And one cried to another and said: "Holy, holy, holy [is] the LORD of hosts; The whole earth [is] full of His glory!"

entries.title: Isaiah 6:4
segments: And the posts of the door were shaken by the voice of him who cried out, and the house was filled with smoke.

entries.title: Isaiah 6:5
segments: ¶So I said: "Woe [is] me, for I am undone! Because I [am] a man of unclean lips, And I dwell in the midst of a people of unclean lips; For my eyes have seen the King, The LORD of hosts."

entries.title: Isaiah 6:6
segments: Then one of the seraphim flew to me, having in his hand a live coal [which] he had taken with the tongs from the altar.

entries.title: Isaiah 6:7
segments: And he touched my mouth [with it], and said: "Behold, this has touched your lips; Your iniquity is taken away, And your sin purged."

entries.title: Isaiah 6:8
segments: Also I heard the voice of the Lord, saying: "Whom shall I send, And who will go for Us?" Then I said, "Here [am] I! Send me."

entries.title: Isaiah 6:9
segments: ¶And He said, "Go, and tell this people: 'Keep on hearing, but do not understand; Keep on seeing, but do not perceive.'

entries.title: Isaiah 6:10
segments: "Make the heart of this people dull, And their ears heavy, And shut their eyes; Lest they see with their eyes, And hear with their ears, And understand with their heart, And return and be healed."

entries.title: Isaiah 6:11
segments: Then I said, "Lord, how long?" And He answered: "Until the cities are laid waste and without inhabitant, The houses are without a man, The land is utterly desolate,

entries.title: Isaiah 6:12
segments: The LORD has removed men far away, And the forsaken places [are] many in the midst of the land.

entries.title: Isaiah 6:13
segments: But yet a tenth [will be] in it, And will return and be for consuming, As a terebinth tree or as an oak, Whose stump [remains] when it is cut down. So the holy seed [shall be] its stump."
